js: 'Chat voice WP1: the Voice group of Settings → Chat, the Voice section of a thread, the voice default of a folder. Any dev instance or dev copy on :8899 (no upstream needed). Saves chat_voice_language = de and chat_turn_detection = push_to_talk, and creates a thread (its audio input set to local) and a folder. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-voice-settings.json --token-file <dir>.token'

expect: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#f-chat-voice-audio-input').textContent; return t.includes('experimental') && t.includes('a cloud chat model never gets audio') && t.includes('a cloud speech-to-text model still receives the audio'); })()
label: audio input says it is experimental, that a cloud chat model never gets audio, and that a cloud speech-to-text model still does
